prose: Kurtis R. Kallenbach joins InnerVerse to discuss the origin of the species, and how knowing your authentic source invalidates the legal black magic of legal person-hood. With a new perspective on what wholeness really means, this eye opening chat will definitely get you thinking differently about your birth/berth-day, as we uncover the root of strawman-sorcery.
ext: We look closer at the after-birth bounty hunters, affidavits affirming one's godly origin, etymological and biblical evidence for the overarching thesis, and a deciphering of the cult of Helios going back to ancient times.
dropped: in the block (Spirit Whirled audiobook narrated by Chance)
